sports.name: Humanoid Soccer
sports.pitch: Three humanoid robots a side play under RoboCup rules and find the ball with a head camera alone.
sports.team: 3 v 3; one agent controls the whole team
sports.rules: RoboCup Humanoid League 2026 (v1.1.1), Large division 3 v 3
sports.control: A target for every joint every 20 ms

Getting up after a fall: a fallen robot returns only once it has stood up by itself
